text: The watcher checks at start that it can run each coding agent it may be asked for (#153's step 6): its own, and every one a project's manifest names on the base branch. Each agent's CLI must run and be signed in: Claude Code's by the loggedIn that claude auth status --json reports, and Codex's by codex login status in Codex's own home, whose exit says. The checks show nothing the CLIs say, start no run and spend nothing. Missing any, the watcher doesn't start, and names the fix for each, as D-0120's check does for a repository. A manifest that names an agent this watcher can't run at all stops it too, while an agent that only an issue's own line picks is still answered on that issue.
